text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Matikanefukukitaru has a
number
of victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Traineeer! I come with good news! Glad
tidings!
Music to your ears!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The moment is finally upon us! Look at
this
fortune slip, freshly pulled and
opened!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She hands me a crisp, new fortune slip.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when we won that
raffle, but
the gods told us to wait a
year? You know, for
the hot spring?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well it's been a year, so I drew another
fortune.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This one says, "Eh, why not take that
trip?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pretty direct for a fortune, don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't really say one way or the other,
but it
looks like the gods have finally
given us their
blessing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And when destiny beckons, we must
answer its
call! ...Sure, this destiny
beckoned nearly a year
ago, but there's
no time like the present!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
We don't have to worry about the
Twinkle Series,
so let's get this hot
spring trip of fortune started!
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pack your bags with lots of snacks, and
let's start
making tracks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our bags stuffed to the brim with
treats, we
set off on our hot spring
vacation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... The water was so great. This
place must
be what paradise feels like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice the auspicious golden
color of the
sulfur bath? Praise be on
high!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you have a nice, relaxing
time too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hoho! Your face certainly tells me you're
all
loosened up! Now then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it up a notch! Time to get this
happy
bonanza started!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We're not here just to get all
toasty in
the hot spring, you know!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We're not here just to get all
toasty in
the hot spring, you know!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today we break free from the track and
celebrate
our hard work with a joyous
jubilee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I want to throw a bash that will send
even the
gods to seventh heaven!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Got that, Trainer?! Tonight, we're going
to have
the happiest get-together, filled
with lots of tea
and singing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's really getting into this... Could it
be she's
been wanting to have a party
this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "Oracle of Happiness" sure knows
how to
celebrate. Or maybe this is just a
side of her I had
never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, ma'am! We'll take a boatload
of sushi
and one of every single special
item on the menu!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And now, some entertainment to go with
your
meal. Trainer, allow me to present
to you my
one-Uma show!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I start on the lavish feast,

Matikanefukukitaru begins an
impersonation
routine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
For my first impression... An Umamusume
who's
falling behind but still gives it her
all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "No waaay!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
For my next impression... The deadpan
Suzuka
after she becomes a god!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I hope your wish comes true. Okay...
bye."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And for my third impression... An
Umamusume
tarot reading!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Huh?! I didn't even know 'The Sprinter'
was part
of the tarot deck!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru fires off impressions
one after
another, some hilarious, others
baffling.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... And now, for impression number sixty-four... The god of war, Bishamonten... after falling into a pond...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? Oh, yeah. I guess I got a little
carried
away there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But first... I think it's time for a nap...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worn out from a day of extreme fun, she
nods off
on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice something slip out of her hand
while I'm
looking for a place for her to
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a joke book containing every single
one of her
impressions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's written down so much material...
Her
handwriting is a little sloppy, and I
can tell things
have been erased and
rewritten many times over.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Trainer... There's still so much more fun ahead...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for everything you did for me... in the Twinkle Series... Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The whole time I thought the "Oracle of

Happiness" wanted to throw down and
party.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But all she wanted to do was to show her

appreciation...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Snort! Zzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find somewhere for the greatest lucky
goddess
around to snooze and then
cover her with a
blanket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Matikanefukukitaru and I
have
formed an irreplaceable bond
during our time
together.
